sections.name: Alien Grunt
sections.card:
Summary: An armoured alien trooper from Xen with 120 health. Around the facility it fires a burst of hornets and then closes in. In Xen it moves more nimbly: faster sideways, and it leaps up to higher ground.
Weak points: The unarmoured part of its torso: one crossbow bolt kills it there, even on Hard.
Looks like: A stocky, upright two-legged alien in armour, with a small extra arm on its chest.
Tips: Its hornets do not home in on you. A hornet hit does 9 damage and a punch 30. The kind with no armour and no Hivehand has none to fire and simply charges at you.

sections.name: Headcrab
sections.card:
Summary: A small parasite about the size of a person's head that leaps up to 3 metres (10 feet) at its target. It is the first enemy you meet.
Weak points: One crowbar hit or two Glock 17 shots kill it on every difficulty. Dodge its leap and it is slow to come back round, or it backs off.
Looks like: Smooth-skinned, with four short, strong legs.
Tips: Some burrow into the ground and come out as you walk up, and its small size makes it hard to hit. Heavy props kill it, it drowns in water, and a flare sets it alight.

sections.name: Zombies
sections.card:
Summary: People taken over by headcrabs. They only fight up close, clawing at you. They come as scientists, guards and marines, plus a tougher suited kind.
Weak points: The suited kind is much tougher than the rest, and its head is the only part its suit does not cover.
Looks like: A person with a headcrab on the head and a body that is rotting open. Some are torso-only; the suited kind wears an HEV suit.
Tips: They can punch props and objects so that they fly at you. Shots to some body parts stagger them. Shots from the chest down can spare the headcrab, which then leaves its host. A flare sets them alight.

sections.name: Vortigaunt
sections.card:
Summary: An alien that dodges when you aim at it and uses a shockwave when you get close.
Looks like: A small extra arm grows from its chest, and it leans forward. Green bands on its neck and arms look like restraints, and its skin looks like a snail's.
Tips: Their ground slam kills snarks instantly, so keep snarks for fights without them.

sections.name: Barnacle
sections.card:
Summary: A creature that hangs from the ceiling and pulls up the props and people it grabs with its tongue.
Tips: It takes three crowbar hits. A person it grabs is squeezed, and freeing them does not save them. On Xen an underwater kind hangs upside down from the bottom; only the crowbar, Glock 17, crossbow, RPG, Hivehand and explosives kill it.

sections.name: Bullsquid
sections.card:
Summary: A spitting alien predator that stays calm until you come into its sight.
Looks like: Its eyes sit on the top of its head, like a water hunter's.
Tips: Spit that lands in water slows down and stops, and touching a broken-up blob does no damage.

sections.name: Alien Controller
sections.card:
Summary: An alien that throws clusters of energy balls and can take over Vortigaunts' minds.
Looks like: Crystals around it serve as armour, and it glows orange when it lifts objects.
Tips: It dodges when you aim at it, and it teleports in when an alarm sounds.

sections.name: Black Ops assassins
sections.card:
Summary: Female Black Ops assassins fight with a Glock 17 in each hand and do not throw grenades.
Looks like: Black boots that look like Portal's long-fall boots, and pistols with no visible suppressor.
Tips: The pistols sound silenced. Their boots keep them from being hurt by falls. They come looking for you rather than waiting in place.

sections.name: Snark
sections.card:
Summary: A thrown beetle-like creature. Once released it attacks enemies and then bursts in a small cloud of acidic blood.
Uses: Their damage is all explosive, so armour does not reduce it, and a swarm can tear apart Alien Grunts and armoured vehicles. Five are enough for one marine squad; save ten to fifteen for a big fight.
Tips: Ammo is scarce: under 70 snarks in the whole game, 5 from each nest and 15 carried at most. You can lob them gently or throw them across a room, and drop them. Their chirps show how much fight they have left.

sections.name: Crossbow
sections.card:
Summary: A silent bolt gun that hits very hard but fires slowly and carries only 10 bolts.
Uses: One of the few weapons that can kill an underwater barnacle.
Tips: Bolts no longer ricochet in the Steam release.

sections.name: Flare
sections.card:
Summary: A flare you can pick up and use as a weapon: it sets enemies on fire.
Uses: Burns zombies and headcrabs. Early on, before you find the crowbar, it is how you fend off the zombies.
Tips: Fire spreads when there is an exposed gas leak, so keep clear. Flares turn up in labs, and they also mark where a supply cache is close.

sections.name: First Aid Kit
sections.card:
Summary: A health pickup that comes in two sizes: a common blue one and a rare green one.
Uses: Restores 10 health (blue) or 25 health (green).
Tips: Marine medics can drop a kit when killed, and green ones less often than blue. A wall First Aid Station is a separate refill: its tubes and lights show how much is left, and it closes when empty.
